title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: Right anterior chest and shoulder from above, patient supine with the arm abducted to 90 degrees: head at the top, the patient's right on the image left.
teachingPoint: Start oblique below the lateral third of the clavicle, then slide inferolaterally to the 3rd-4th rib at the anterior axillary line for PECS II; needle in-plane from the medial end.
claims: Supine, right arm abducted to 90 degrees (record); patient's right on the image left (house laterality).
Linear probe at the PECS II position: oblique over the 3rd-4th rib at the anterior axillary line, at the front edge of the armpit fold, above and lateral to the nipple (record, updated 2026-10-02).
Needle entering beyond the probe's medial end, in line with it: in-plane from medial to lateral (record).
Labels: Clavicle, Linear probe, Block needle.
